meta.name: security-research
meta.description: Team Mode security research skill. Orchestrates 3 vulnerability hunters and 2 PoC engineers to audit a codebase in parallel, prove exploitability, classify root causes, and calibrate severity by actual exploitability. Use for security review, vulnerability research, exploitability audit, pre-release security check, threat model validation, and `/security-research`. Triggers: 'security-research', 'security research', 'security review', 'vulnerability audit', 'exploitability audit', '보안 리뷰', '취약점 감사'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把代码库交给多名漏洞猎手和验证工程师并行审查,找出真正可利用的缺陷并定级。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果发布前想确认代码里没有被忽视的可利用漏洞。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to confirm exploitable flaws before shipping.

howto.what: Claude 会组建 5 人团队(3 名漏洞猎人和 2 名 PoC 工程师)并行审计代码库:先找候选漏洞,再用最小 PoC 验证是否真能利用,按实际可利用性定级,最后输出含结论、发现清单、被降级项与残留风险的报告。
howto.when: 当你说“security-research”“安全审查”等关键词,或要求做发布前安全检查、威胁模型验证时触发;需已开启 team mode,否则它会停下并让你改配置。

say.text: 审查当前分支的 diff,找出可利用的漏洞并给出 PoC
say.note: 会走猎人排查与 PoC 验证流程

say.text: 对这个仓库做发布前安全检查,按可利用性给出结论
验证这个威胁模型里的攻击路径是否真的成立
say.note: 无法安全运行的 PoC 会改用静态或干跑证明

howto.what_en: Claude spins up a 5-member team (3 hunters + 2 PoC engineers) to audit a codebase in parallel: hunters list candidate flaws, PoCs try to prove or falsify exploitability, severity follows real exploitability, and it ends with a verdict report.
howto.when_en: Triggers on security review, vulnerability research, exploitability audit, pre-release check, threat model validation, or /security-research. Requires team mode enabled, else it stops and tells you to update config.

say_en.text: Audit the current branch diff for exploitable flaws and give me a PoC
say_en.note: Runs the hunter pass and PoC verification

say_en.text: Run a pre-release security check on this repo and report by exploitability
say_en.note: Returns PASS / PASS WITH FINDINGS / BLOCK

say_en.text: Test whether the attack paths in this threat model actually hold
say_en.note: Unsafe PoCs become static or dry-run proof
